about.title: Search inside
about.subtitle: every video.
about.description: NoeticSearch is a video transcript search platform. Import PeerTube videos, query their subtitles with AI, and find exact quotes across your library.
about.feature1Description: We support PeerTube, the federated open-source video platform. Import any public video and make your searches discoverable by the community.
about.feature2Description: Your search history and library are private by default. Share only what you explicitly choose to make public.
about.feature3Description: Our assistant understands natural-language queries and finds the most relevant transcript segments across your entire library.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: Policy.
privacy.collectContent: We collect the minimum data needed to provide the service:
privacy.collectItem1: Email address and display name (account creation)
privacy.collectItem2: Videos you import and their associated metadata and transcripts
privacy.useContent: Your data is used solely to operate NoeticSearch. We do not sell, share, or monetize your personal information with third parties.
privacy.visibilityContent: All searches and videos are private by default. You may choose to mark them as public, which makes them visible to other users and on the home page.
privacy.deletionContent: You can delete individual searches, imported videos, or your entire account at any time from the Settings page. Deletion is permanent and immediate.
privacy.contactContent: For privacy-related questions or data requests, reach out to privacy@noeticsearch.com.
